description: Set up who is paged in a project that pages nobody yet, as the on-call guided setup does: the policy "Default on-call policy" paging the person (unless includeMe is false), alsoPage and teams, with on-call rules that run it for every new incident and alert. escalateTo and escalateToTeams are paged next after afterMinutes; repeatTimes starts it over. A project with on-call policies or rules is refused. For reachMeBy, details say what the person must still add. Acts as the person signed in (OAuth), with their permissions; an API key cannot.

afterMinutes.description: Minutes to wait for an acknowledgement, 1 to 1440. Defaults to 30.

alsoPage.description: Members to page, by name or email.

escalateTo.description: Members paged next, by name or email.

includeMe.description: Page the person signed in. Defaults to true.

reachMeBy.description: How the person asked to be reached.

name: set_up_paging
title: Set Up Paging
